title: Eight Sleep
description: Calm premium-hardware white: a white page with #f7f7f7 bands and #f0f0f0 cards, near-black text, warm-grey body copy, pure black buttons, one sparing electric blue. Dark is the site's night: true black and a black-to-navy sky with white glass cards and white buttons. A neo-grotesk at 400/500 only, a mono for eyebrows, a condensed gothic for big figures and a narrow serif for quotes.
notes: light is the faithful mode: the eightsleep dark bands (film, night carousel, advisors, reviews, footer) force themselves dark with the dark class
Hanken Grotesk stands in for Neue Montreal (closed); IBM Plex Mono is the original's own mono
two extra variables, --eightsleep-figures (Oswald) and --eightsleep-quote (Instrument Serif), feed the condensed figures and the review quotes; blocks fall back to the display face under other themes
name: eightsleep-theme
